segments.sn19.5:1.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ asilomaṃ purisaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ.
segments.sn19.5:1.2: Tassa te asī uppatitvā uppatitvā tasseva kāye nipatanti.
segments.sn19.5:1.3: So sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … pe … eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃyeva rājagahe sūkariko ahosi … pe ….
